csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR), through the Division of Parks and Watercraft is responsible for the management of Ohio s State Parks, 16 of which offer overnight rental opportunities for individual, one, two, and three bedroom cabins. Cabins were constructed in the parks between 1940 and 2026 with many undergoing minor renovations to date. ODNR has previously conducted assessments with several rounds of improvements completed to the cabins at multiple Park locations. This project serves as a continuation of those efforts with renovations to cabins at both Lake Hope State Park in Vinton County and Maumee State Park in Lucas County (managed by concessionaires in partnership with ODNR). The selected team will develop site-specific plans and reconcile any existing master plans for selected locations, beginning with the confirmation of facility and site assessments. These reconciliations will address the site utilization needs of various user groups, and utility infrastructure needs versus constraints. They will also include recommended scopes of construction projects and appropriate phasing.
